releaseNotes: 修复真实客户端验收误清除活动皮肤的问题并新增活动会话保护；恢复豆包 2.19.9 的双层皮肤背景；WorkBuddy 5.3.5 新建任务显示静止挂件，历史对话才启用按皮肤往返运动；滚动回程方向与走动、爬行、漂浮掉头朝向同步修正。
releaseNotesEn: Prevents real-client QA from clearing an active skin; restores both Doubao 2.19.9 background layers; keeps the WorkBuddy 5.3.5 New Task mascot stationary while enabling per-theme traversal only in conversation history; and corrects return rotation and turn-around direction for all supported motions.
